subject: Medford Square Zoning Amendment
overview: The board continued a site plan review for Riverside Avenue and conducted an extensive working session with consultants regarding the proposed Medford Square zoning amendment. Discussion focused on balancing redevelopment with parking requirements and historic preservation.

items.title: 400 Riverside Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to March 4, 2026, because reviews regarding fire access and ADA compliance are still pending due to staff absences.

items.title: Medford Square District Zoning Amendment Working Session
items.summary: Consultants presented shadow studies, use tables, and dimensional standards for four proposed sub-districts intended to facilitate mixed-use development. The board debated requirements for 'active' ground floors, the inclusion of historic preservation 'carrots' to prevent teardowns, and the potential for a municipal parking garage to alleviate scarcity. Members expressed concern that existing parking minimums might hinder redevelopment and suggested using the city-owned 'Transom' parcels as a pilot case for the new standards.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Adjournment
items.summary: Staff announced the appointment of a new head clerk and reviewed logistics for the upcoming joint hearing with the City Council before adjourning.
